entry.title: Bother Bin: Stop Overthinking
entry.content:

All Price Information

Price：Free

In-App Purchases

  • Bother Bin Pro：$3.99

Application Description

Overthinking at 2am? Write it down, put it down, and let it go. Bother Bin is a quiet place to set down whatever is circling in your head, then log the small steps as they happen, at your own pace. Nothing nags. Nothing expires. Everything stays on your device. No account, no tracking, no ads. Export a full backup anytime. When overthinking hits, Bother Bin helps you clear your mind instantly. Turn anxiety into action by defining the smallest next step. A built-in timeline tracks your progress, helping you build real momentum and confidence. Stay focused with smart filters and flexible sorting to see how far you’ve come. Fully private, with zero tracking and all data stored on your device. 【 Who It’s For 】 * Overthinkers who want to become "doers." * Minimalists seeking a pure, quiet space. * Life-long learners tracking their evolution. * High achievers battling the inner critic. * Driven students and professionals. 【 Struggles We Solve 】 * Mental Clutter * Analysis Paralysis * The "Not Enough" Trap * Endless Overthinking * Imposter Syndrome * The Stalling Habit * Procrastination 【 Core Features 】 • Offload anxious thoughts or ideas instantly • Turn thoughts into small, actionable steps • Track progress with an automatic timeline • Stay focused with simple filters • Sort your progress forward or backward • 100% private, stored on your device • Tag topics and filter by tag (Pro) • On Hold, for things you're setting aside for now • Pin what matters to the top • Export a full backup anytime 【 Free & Pro 】 The free version holds up to 7 topics, with progress logs, filters, pinning and backups included. Buy Pro once for unlimited topics, tags, and future features. No subscription, no ads, no tracking. If you bought Bother Bin before, you already have Pro. 【 User Reviews 】 "I can't live without it!“ ”Writing my worries down and watching them get solved one by one has given me so much hope." "I log my experiment results here. It makes me feel like I'm still moving forward, even when an experiment fails." "The most intuitive tool I’ve used. It looks simple but fits so many scenarios. My life finally feels organized." "My go-to app for those late nights when I can’t stop thinking." No path is ever wasted. Every entry marks a new chapter of progress. Bother Bin turns anxiety into trackable steps, so you can build real confidence.

entry.content:
Discount Information

In-App Purchases

All Price Information

Price：$3.99

In-App Purchases

  • Premium：$29.99
  • Fitness Buddy Premium：$9.99

Application Description

Build muscle, gain strength, and lose weight with personalized workout routines tailored to your goals, fitness level, and available equipment. Every workout is designed to match your individual needs, allowing you to make lasting progress on your terms. Transform your health and lifestyle with a comprehensive approach to fitness that includes not just exercise, but also diet and habit formation. It's your ultimate companion for a healthier, stronger you. Unlock Your Full Fitness Potential with Fitness Buddy – Your Ultimate Workout Partner Celebrated by Users & Fitness Experts Alike ◆ Comprehensive Workout & Nutrition Planner: Tailored fitness plans for home and gym workouts. ◆ Extensive Exercise Database: Over 2400 exercises with detailed video guides and animations. ◆ Customizable Fitness Programs: Personalize your workout frequency and program duration to fit your lifestyle. ◆ Goal-Oriented Training Plans: Specific plans for weight loss, muscle gain, and improving overall fitness. ◆ Advanced Tracking Features: Monitor your progress with intuitive workout, nutrition, and body metric tracking. ◆ User-Centric Design: Easily select workouts based on available equipment and your training preferences. ◆ Diverse Fitness Content: From strength training to yoga, cater to all your fitness needs in one app. Empower Your Workout Experience ◆ Personalized Workout Guides: Enjoy workouts customized to your fitness level and goals. ◆ Dynamic Workout Routines: Varied programs to keep you engaged and ensure continuous progress. ◆ Build Your Own Routines: Save, modify, and create workouts that suit your preference. 1000+ Exercise Tutorials ◆ High-Quality Instructional Content: Multi-angle videos and comprehensive exercise descriptions. ◆ Versatile Exercise Search: Find exercises by muscle group, equipment, or keyword. ◆ All-Inclusive Fitness: Including cardio, mobility exercises, and options for every fitness level. ◆ Regular Content Updates: Always expanding the exercise library for an optimized workout experience. Optimize Your Nutrition ◆ Customized Meal Plans: Tailor your diet with options like keto, paleo, fasting, and vegetarian to suit your lifestyle. ◆ Delicious, Healthy Recipes: Explore hundreds of tasty, nutritious recipes that align with your meal plan. ◆ Nutritional Insights: Gain detailed calorie and nutrition information for each recipe, empowering your dietary choices. Seamless Integrations ◆ Health App Connectivity: Sync with Apple Health for a unified fitness tracking experience. ◆ Wearable Integration: Compatible with popular fitness trackers and available on iOS devices. Subscription Details Unlock full access with an easy subscription, available monthly or yearly, directly through your iTunes account. ◆ Flexible Subscription Options: Choose what works best for you. ◆ Hassle-Free Management: Easily manage your subscription through your account settings. ◆ Continuous Updates & Support: Get all the latest features and premium content to keep your fitness journey on track. Embark on a transformative fitness journey with Fitness Buddy, where your dedication meets our comprehensive support for unparalleled fitness achievements. Subscriptions auto-renew monthly or yearly, with charges to your iTunes upon purchase confirmation. Turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings at least 24 hours before the period ends to prevent renewal charges. Unused trial portions are forfeited upon cancellation. For full terms and privacy details, visit: https://www.azumio.com/page/privacypolicy

般若心灯是一款佛教经典导读、念佛计数与佛乐聆听应用，帮助您随时随地诵读经文、聆听梵音、记录功课，在日常中安住身心、亲近佛法。 【经书收录】 收录心经、金刚经、普门品、药师经、普光明藏经、阿弥陀经、法华经、六祖坛经、楞严经、地藏经等经典，大悲咒、楞严咒、准提咒、百字明咒、往生咒、绿度母心咒等咒语真言，以及大忏悔文、回向文、课诵仪轨、药师经仪轨、地藏经 前仪等课诵内容，共二十四部经典与仪轨，持续更新中。 【课诵仪轨】 香赞、净口业与净三业真言、安土地真言、普供养真言、开经偈为前行，补阙真言、普回向真言、三皈依为结行，诵持任一经典皆可依用；另立药师专篇，收药师赞、药师偈与药师灌顶真言。 【逐字拼音】 每一个汉字上方都标注了准确的拼音，方便初学者正确诵读经文，不再因生僻字而困扰。 【白话文解释】 关键经文配有通俗易懂的白话文解释，轻触即可查看，帮助您深入理解经文含义。 【经文朗读】 部分经典内置音频朗读，支持进度拖动、0.25x 至 2.0x 变速播放，以及后台与锁屏播放；未配音的经典仍可使用逐字拼音安心诵读。 【歌词式阅读指示】 阅读经文时，屏幕中央显示虚线定位指示器与当前行号，当前行高亮、远处渐淡，方便随时找回诵读位置。 【佛乐聆听】 精选 34 首佛教音乐，涵盖大悲咒、密咒真言、凡歌咏法、一心念佛等八大分类，支持播放列表、上下曲切换、进度拖动与变速播放，后台锁屏亦可聆听。可设 10 至 90 分钟定时关闭或「播完本曲」，到点前音量渐渐淡出，不会突然静下 来。 【佛珠念佛】 轻触或沿珠串滑动即可拨珠计数，每颗都有木珠相碰的音效与触感反馈，108 颗圆满一圈。本次声数叠在佛珠环心，今日与本圈进度并列其下；长按佛珠可按本次、今日、累计分别归零。圣号可下拉切换或自行添加，拨珠音色可选佛珠或木 鱼，振动强度分轻、中、强三档。自动记录今日声数与念佛时长，可一键生成水墨风格卡片分享今日修持。 【自定义功课】 可新建功课，设定名称、圣号、总目标与目标天数，每天该念多少自动算出。念佛页显示目标进度、剩余声数与今日完成情况，每份功课可单独设定回向文，发愿时自动填入；达成每日目标或圆满总目标时给出提示。 【佛历】 二十七个佛菩萨圣诞与初一、十五集中一页，按农历月分组，农历与公历对照，只列当年剩余的日子。可开启提醒，于前一日傍晚收到通知，斋日提醒可单独开关。 【修行打卡】 每日打卡记录修行，日历视图直观展示诵经轨迹，连续天数激励您坚持修行。偶尔忘记打卡也无妨，支持补打最近数日的功课，连续天数自动接上。 【功德牌与足迹】 诵读、打卡、念佛皆可累积功德牌，涵盖单经精进、广学多闻、持之以恒、念佛功课与佛菩萨圣诞时节。轻触日历上的打卡点，可回看那一天诵读过哪些经书，并为当日功课写下心愿。 【发愿回向】 念佛之后可写下愿文与回向，一日多愿亦可分别留档。所有发愿按时间成串收在「发愿记录」中，可随时修改或删除，日后回看重温初心。 【修行回顾】 按年汇总修行天数、最长连续与常诵经典，生成水墨风格回顾卡片，可保存分享。 【iCloud 同步】 开启后，打卡记录、功德牌、诵经进度、自定义功课与圣号在您的各台设备间保持一致，无需额外费用。 【个性设置】 支持夜间模式，经文字号自由调节，打造舒适的阅读体验。 【收藏与进度】 收藏常读经书，自动记录阅读进度，每次打开都能继续上次的修行。 般若心灯，愿以智慧之光，照亮您的修行之路。 【随喜护持】 佛经、佛咒与仪轨全部免费诵读。念佛计数、佛乐聆听与离线下载、修行记录与打卡、自定义背景与佛像、经文听诵、自定义功课、年度回顾为护持功能，可选月度护持、年度护持（自动续订，可随时在 Apple ID 设置中取消）或终身护持（一次性购买）。付费下载时期已购买的用户自动视为终身护持。 使用条款（EULA）：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ 隐私政策：https://prajnalamp.com/privacy

Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world. - A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go? - A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner.
